name: Hasselback Sausage with Maple-Roasted Apples, Veggies & Couscous

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small butternut squash
0.68 kg Brussels sprouts
3 Gala apples

instructions.primary_message: Trim ends and peel each squash; halve lengthwise, scrape out seeds, and cut the flesh into 1-inch cubes. Divide between two baking sheet pans.
Trim Brussels sprouts and halve lengthwise; add to the baking sheets with the squash.
Quarter and core apples, then slice each quarter into wedges; add to the baking sheets.
Peel, trim, and quarter shallots lengthwise. Add to the baking sheets, keeping the quarters intact.
Drizzle maple syrup and oil over the apple and veggies. Season with salt and pepper, toss to combine, then spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tbsp pure maple syrup
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To hasselback the sausages, thinly slice each sausage crosswise, stopping ½-inch before the bottom (be careful not to slice all the way through).
Place sausages, cut-side up, on the baking sheets, nestling them into the apple and veggies.
Place baking sheets in the oven and bake until apple and veggies are tender and sausages are cooked through, about 25 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, in a medium saucepan, bring broth to a boil. Remove from heat, add couscous and salt, and stir to combine; cover and let stand for 10 minutes. Fluff with a fork.
instructions.secondary_message:
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth
1 ½ cups whole wheat couscous
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: To serve, divide apples, veggies, sausages, and couscous between plates. Enjoy!
